Container.Name: Marquee
Container.Overview: A MAME library manager in the shape of Sonarr. Pick the games you want, fetch only those through your own download client, and keep a categorised, verified library - with an EmulationStation gamelist - current across MAME releases. The library can be a share on this server or a console reached over SMB, FTP or SFTP.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Settings, the API key, and the cache of MAME XML and catlist files.

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: The torrent folder: the same files your download client writes to.

Config.Name: Library
Config.Description: The categorised library, when it lives on this server. Unused when the library is on a console reached over SMB, FTP or SFTP.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the files belong to. Use the same one as your download client.

Config.Name: API key
Config.Description: Optional. Left empty, one is generated on the first start and shown in the log with the URL to open.
